pokedexEntries.sw: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

pokedexEntries.sh: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon was brought to Paldea long ago by people from a faraway land. It’s so strong that it can easily pull an airplane.

pokedexEntries.vi: Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.
